title: Mutually Derivable States Kept in Tandem
pattern: Tracking a numeric collection size and an empty/full boolean indicator as separate mutable fields updated inside every mutation method.
why_bad: Two sources of truth. A bug in any structural modifier method can lead to desynchronization where `count == 0` but `is_empty_flag == false`.
detection: A class/struct with fields tracking count and emptiness/fullness together that are modified in parallel within mutation blocks.
counterexample: Highly specialized, lock-free concurrent structures that require atomic booleans for hardware reads.
